baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two b-l-w verbs at words 1 and 7 frame knowing the strivers and the patient and then testing their reports.
baseline_models.mechanism: A first pass puts persons under trial until effort and restraint become manifest; a second pass assays the reports produced by, about, or from them. The repeated verb makes a trial-manifestation-trial loop rather than a single undifferentiated ordeal.

activation_trace.role: Testing that makes a condition appear supplies both passes of the assay and links pressure to manifested quality.
Disclosure to a knower marks the transition from latent capacity to an inspectable condition.
Expenditure of capacity under hardship supplies the active quality manifested in the first pass.
Holding the self back from collapse supplies the retained quality manifested beside effort.
News joined to knowledge of an affair's interior makes the second pass an assay of evidence, not mere rumor.

changed_reading.before: The ayah promises a generic ordeal that sorts good people from bad people.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages two linked assays: pressure first makes capacities manifest in persons, then the resulting reports or evidence are themselves tested.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'until We know' stands between trial and named classes, while 'your reports' is the object of a renewed trial.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trial converts an inward disposition into a distinguishing mark, and the renewed trial checks the account attached to that mark. Striver and patient therefore function as evidenced classifications produced in time, not merely labels announced in advance.

activation_trace.role: An examination that reveals quality supplies the event that turns disposition into evidence.
A differentiating sign supplies the visible or legible mark by which the tested class becomes identifiable.
Knowledge of news and the inside of an affair supplies the evidentiary dossier checked after the mark appears.

changed_reading.before: Knowing simply names divine awareness of who already belongs to each class.
changed_reading.after: Knowing is read as the production of differentiating evidence: trial gives latent qualities a mark and then tests the account that the mark supports.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus coordinates the strivers and the patient as separately named outputs of one test.
baseline_models.mechanism: J-h-d sends capacity outward to its difficult limit, while s-b-r holds the self inward against panic or retreat. The assay looks for a coupled but non-identical pair of capacities: forceful expenditure and durable containment.

activation_trace.role: Maximum exertion under hardship provides the outward vector of tested capacity.
Self-restraint against disintegration provides the inward holding vector of tested capacity.
Revelatory testing distinguishes whether either capacity is actually present under load.

changed_reading.before: Striving and patience are near-synonymous names for general steadfastness.
changed_reading.after: The test resolves two coexisting dimensions, expenditure and containment, which may overlap in persons without collapsing into one virtue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier explicit formula of testing some people by means of others supplies a social medium for the focus test. Encounter, resistance, and dependence make each party an instrument through which the other's effort and restraint become manifest.

activation_trace.role: The focus repeats revelatory testing as the governing operation whose social medium needs specification.
The earlier occurrence explicitly casts the encounter as a test that makes the parties' conditions appear.
The partition into some and others assigns human counterparts the functional role of reciprocal test media.

structural_cues: 47:4 states that some are tested by means of others inside a staged encounter.
47:31 returns to b-l-w and identifies tested classes from among the addressed group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal testing in 47:4 and renewed testing in 47:31; I infer that human encounter is one mechanism by which the focus categories become manifest. A live alternative is that 47:31 names a broader direct divine test not limited to that encounter.

changed_reading.before: The test is an isolated ordeal applied vertically to each individual.
changed_reading.after: The test can be socially mediated: people expose one another's capacities, so the field of relation is part of the assay rather than incidental scenery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance, repair of condition, and increased guidance surround the tested population with processes that alter capacity. The beneficent branch of b-l-w permits the assay to be formative: it can disclose effort and patience while also cultivating the condition from which they arise.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent doing within b-l-w keeps trial open as an intervention that can confer or cultivate good, not only diagnose.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies a process that changes the tested subject's trajectory.
Making a thing fit supplies active repair rather than mere post-test classification.
Soundness and ease of condition locates the repair in the subject's operative state.
Increase and growth supply an iterative gain in capacity rather than a fixed trait inventory.
Guidance appearing both as prior orientation and added guidance makes development responsive to an already enacted step.

structural_cues: 47:5 joins guidance to repair of condition after the ordeal sequence.
47:17 describes guidance increasing for those who have taken guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repair and incremental guidance around tested agents; I infer that at least one function of trial is to form the capacities it reveals. The live alternative is that repair and increase are consequences after testing rather than operations within it.

changed_reading.before: Trial only measures a fixed stock of courage and patience.
changed_reading.after: Trial may be both diagnostic and formative, eliciting a response and then repairing or increasing the capacity that can answer the next demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from requesting speech, to bodily recoil when fighting is stated, to the claim of obedience and recognized speech, and finally to the moment when the matter becomes resolved. Truth is then the conversion of a report into action at the decision threshold.

activation_trace.role: News that reaches the inside of an affair lets 'your reports' include claims whose inward truth can be checked.
Overt utterance supplies the initial request whose practical force is later tested.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply the embodied contradiction that appears when the requested command arrives.
Obedient yielding supplies the declared posture that must cross from speech into performance.
Recognized speech supplies the verbal report whose adequacy is not yet established by wording alone.
A matter becoming firmly resolved supplies the load point at which verbal posture meets irreversible demand.
Fulfilling promise by deed defines truth here as enacted correspondence rather than accurate wording alone.

structural_cues: 47:20 begins with a request for a surah but changes affectively when fighting is named.
47:21 places obedience and acceptable speech before the matter hardens into resolve, then asks for truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech-demand-action sequence and a contrast between utterance and truthfulness; I infer that testing 'your reports' verifies self-description through conduct at resolution. A live alternative is that 'reports' means the record of deeds rather than the speakers' own claims.

changed_reading.before: Reports are neutral information collected after the test.
changed_reading.after: Reports include declared loyalties and self-descriptions, and the test is the event that forces those statements either to become deeds or to disclose their failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hidden promise of obedience in only part of the matter creates a divided communication system: public alignment can coexist with a covert, limited commitment. Testing reports therefore reaches channels and partitions of allegiance that ordinary public speech does not expose.

activation_trace.role: News joined to interior knowledge lets the tested object include concealed communications and their underlying alignment.
Speech held inward or not publicly shown supplies the covert side of the report system.
Obedient yielding supplies the promised allegiance whose scope is being negotiated.
Partition into only a part makes the allegiance structurally selective rather than whole.
Knowledge reaching what is concealed provides the epistemic link from secret promise to the focus's tested reports.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden channel that the focus assay must surface.

structural_cues: 47:26 quotes a promise to obey in some of the matter and immediately states knowledge of their secrets.
47:31 renews both knowing and testing with reports as the final object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a secret, partial obedience pact and knowledge of its concealment; I infer that 'reports' can include covert communications and segmented allegiance. A live alternative is that the secrecy concerns intention alone, with no broader intelligence or communication sense intended.

changed_reading.before: The focus tests only visible endurance in open conflict.
changed_reading.after: The focus also assays hidden communication and partial allegiance, exposing where public posture and covert commitment divide.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed interior is brought out, then rendered readable through showing, marks, recognition, tonal inflection, and works. The focus test is therefore a semiotic production process: it amplifies a latent state until it leaves multiple mutually checking traces.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing sign supplies the focus-side hinge from latent disposition to readable evidence.
Interior knowledge carried as news supplies what the produced signs and speech traces are made to report.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the transition from hidden affect to observable output.
Causing something to be seen supplies direct manifestation as one possible disclosure channel.
The split mapping's narration of report or verse lets showing also activate a reported or narrated mode of disclosure.
Recognition after a trace or sign supplies the reader who decodes the manifested evidence.
A visible mark that indicates condition supplies one externally legible trace of the latent state.
The alternate mapped branch also supplies a recognizable sign, reinforcing mark-based disclosure across the split.
Speech bent toward its implication supplies an involuntary tonal or rhetorical trace of hidden alignment.
A thing's saying as its indication makes utterance function as evidence beyond its explicit proposition.
Knowledge of the now-expressed condition closes the same disclosure movement that the focus resumes.
Purposeful deeds provide a nonverbal trace against which marks and tonal reports can be checked.

structural_cues: 47:29 names concealed grudges as what will be brought out; that root has no branch inventory and is used only as structure here.
47:30 sequences showing, recognition by marks, recognition through speech inflection, and knowledge of works immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment-to-exit structure, visible signs, speech inflection, and works; I infer that trial is the process that amplifies an interior state into cross-checkable traces. A live alternative is instantaneous disclosure without trial as its causal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: 'Until We know' sounds like acquisition of previously absent information, and 'reports' sounds like a separate object.
changed_reading.after: The test makes what is inward legible in marks, tonal leakage, and deeds; knowing names manifested evidence, while reports are one layer in a multi-channel disclosure system.

context_deltas.mechanism: A request becomes intensive pressure; withholding follows; then what was hidden is expelled. The non-dominant s-l-l mapping sharpens the sequence into an extraction image: demand draws an inward condition out into an observable refusal.

activation_trace.role: Revelatory testing supplies the general assay that the later conditional demand makes mechanically explicit.
Knowledge of an affair's inside supplies the latent content that pressure converts into reportable behavior.
Request and demand supply the overt input applied to the addressed group.
The split mapping's gentle or hidden drawing-out supplies an extraction image for how a request elicits concealed material.
Exhaustive insistence supplies increased pressure that pushes the probe toward the subject's limit.
Withholding is the enacted response through which the hidden condition becomes behaviorally legible.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the explicit output stage of the pressure-response assay.

structural_cues: 47:37 presents request, exhaustive pressure, withholding, and emergence in a single conditional chain.
The final object in that chain is concealed grudge; its root lacks an inventory and is retained only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conditional demand-pressure-withholding-emergence sequence; I infer that the focus test can operate as a calibrated extraction probe. The live alternative is that 47:37 warns against excessive demand and should not define the mechanism of every trial.

changed_reading.before: Trial is adversity that happens around a person and is later observed.
changed_reading.after: Trial can be a calibrated demand whose intensity draws an inward resistance into an observable choice, effectively generating the report it then tests.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus warning locates the decisive failure point in weakening and calling for settlement while holding the upper position, coupled with assurance that works will not be diminished. Patience becomes maintenance of operative resolve under fatigue, not passive waiting detached from action.

activation_trace.role: Expenditure of capacity under hardship supplies the active motion that must be sustained.
Holding the self from panic or retreat supplies the stabilizing capacity paired with exertion.
Weakness of force and slackening of resolve identify the failure mode against which patience operates.
Calling and verbally inclining toward an exit turns inward fatigue into a public strategic move.
Settlement opposed to war supplies the proposed exit whose timing reveals whether resolve has weakened.
Prevailing position removes simple defeat as the reason for exit and makes slackened resolve diagnostically salient.
Loss that deprives one of a right or work supplies the feared diminishment explicitly denied in the verse.
Purposeful works provide the accumulated action whose preservation supports continued effort.

structural_cues: 47:35 follows the focus with a prohibition on weakening and calling for settlement while in a prevailing position.
The same ayah closes by assuring that works will not be reduced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weakening, a verbal call to settlement, prevailing position, and preserved works; I infer that patience in the focus is active noncollapse at a fatigue threshold. A live alternative is that this is a specific strategic application and does not exhaust patience's wider range.

changed_reading.before: Patience is mainly passive endurance while events run their course.
changed_reading.after: Patience is the holding function that keeps strenuous action from converting fatigue into premature strategic withdrawal, while remaining distinct from effort itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from moral vocabulary into wear, hard ground, stone, and soft soil. It remains valid as a focus-only activation because every image is supplied by a cited focus-root branch and the repeated test gives them a coherent stress-assay relation. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for manifestation under load, not as a lexical replacement for the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Repeated b-l-w is coupled in the focus with j-h-d, s-b-r, and kh-b-r inventories that contain wear, depleted use, hard stone, and soft ground.

activation_trace.role: Wear through use supplies material fatigue as the repeated test's visible effect.
Depletion by mixing or repeated use supplies the load that extracts a material's operative substance.
Coarse stone and pebbly ground supply a resistant material response that holds under the same load.
Soft low ground that receives water supplies the contrasting substrate whose response reveals different internal structure.

changed_reading.before: The tested subjects simply display pre-named moral traits.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can be carried as a material fatigue image: repeated loading abrades, extracts, hardens, or reveals softness, making inner structure readable through response rather than labels.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant q-w-l to q-l-l split to hear carrying, rising, and trembling beneath the speech sequence. It remains anchored by focus 'reports,' the explicit qawl occurrences, and the following moment of resolve. Downstream prose should qualify it as a split-root branch activation that models speech's practical load-bearing capacity, not as the ordinary lexical sense of qawl.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus tests reports, while 47:20-21 moves from utterance to a resolved matter and enacted truth.

activation_trace.role: Report and interior knowledge supply the utterance whose practical reliability is under assay.
Guarantee and sustained attachment supply a commitment image for a report that remains answerable to action.
The split mapping's carrying and rising supplies the image of an utterance able to bear practical weight.
Tremor and disturbance supply the competing image of speech destabilized when its requested demand arrives.
Literal utterance keeps the exploratory carrying image attached to an actual speech construction.
Firm resolution supplies the load point at which speech either carries into action or trembles apart.

changed_reading.before: Testing reports means checking whether their propositions are factually correct.
changed_reading.after: A report is also tested for load-bearing force: can the utterance carry its speaker into resolved action and remain a guarantee, or does it tremble when the demand becomes real?

strongest_changes: The repeated trial becomes a two-pass process that first manifests capacities in persons and then tests the reports or evidence those capacities produce.
The speech sequence in 47:20-21 turns 'your reports' into claims verified by conduct when a matter becomes resolved.
47:29-30 makes trial semiotic: concealed condition exits into marks, tonal leakage, and works that can be cross-checked.
47:37 models demand as an extraction probe whose pressure converts hidden resistance into withholding and observable emergence.
Earlier mutual testing and surrounding repair preserve social and formative readings alongside the diagnostic one.
summary.what_was_special: The nearest context does not merely repeat testing language; it supplies a disclosure mechanism before the focus and a pressure-response mechanism after it. Split mappings add three unusual but coherent activations: showing as narration, asking as drawing-out, and speech as carrying or trembling under load.
remaining_uncertainties: Repair and increased guidance may occur after trial rather than being formative operations within it.
Akhbar may prioritize records of deeds, spoken self-reports, covert communications, or a deliberately coexisting range among them.
The pressure-extraction model is locally strong in 47:37 but may not generalize to every mode of testing in 47:31.
The material-fatigue and load-bearing-speech outliers are branch-grounded analogies and should not be promoted to unqualified lexical glosses.
